column1: # Second-name allowlist for tools/levels/second_names.py (level_gate row NAMES, task #2617).
# One row per SITE: level, function (the C row's name), the address-named extern
# it links against, status, the existing name(s) at exactly that address (comma
# separated, sorted; must equal what the check finds, so the row dies with its
# cause), and why. Small and per site, the RULING #8549 precedent.
#   ACCEPTED  an accepted second name. Add only on watcher-2's acceptance, citing it.
#   PENDING   on master when the check landed (census NOTE #13409 / FACT #13410 at
#             7b55bf87d, re-measured by level_gate at c77da6896), awaiting its
#             respell row. NEVER ADD a PENDING row: the respell row deletes its row
#             in the same landing (RULING #7317, baselines only lowered); a row
#             left behind FAILs the gate as STALE.
#             Task #2646 (class A2, the level's boot-name map) found one member
#             that cannot be respelled byte-neutrally; watcher-2 accepted it at
#             landing (RULING #13537), so it lands ACCEPTED, not PENDING.
